the revelation of a hidden hazard must be able to trigger a simultaneous, uniform penalty across every participating faction at once, rather than harming factions sequentially or requiring separate rolls per faction
the same revealed hazard must be able to carry a distinct cultural/identity-based meaning layered on top of its ordinary economic consequences, with both readings mechanically true at the same time
a public, documented revelation of the hazard must be able to durably shift an unrelated faction's ongoing political costs elsewhere in the world, as a downstream side effect

a specific investigator's thoroughness trait must be able to simultaneously fully expose the causal chain of a scandal AND, through the time that thoroughness takes, hand the implicated parties a window to destroy or hide evidence before the exposure completes

ARC.ends_when: when the hidden contamination is revealed -- either by a successful diagnostic action in the affected territories, or, absent any investigation, by default once enough seasons have passed and the effects simply become visible. ARC.name: Wait Until It Sings

unmapped.need: a faction's default, low-effort defensive behavior must be able to remain unchanged and un-escalated for many consecutive seasons while OTHER factions actively spend themselves down, such that patience alone becomes the winning strategy without that faction ever taking an aggressive action

a reactive procedural objection must be able to fire automatically and identically every time its trigger condition is met, functioning as a standing tax on a category of action rather than a deliberated response

a previously-neutral institution's inertia must be able to become contestable -- vulnerable to being won by an outside faction -- only once specific, hard-to-reach conditions among OTHER factions are simultaneously true

a resource-management relationship between two SEPARATE characters (one who buffers a faction's failure rate, one whose eventual breakdown removes that buffer) must be able to delay a payoff and then, upon that second character's break, accelerate it explosively

co-opting a previously-neutral institutional actor must be able to unlock a specific, otherwise-unreachable category of reform, but only if the co-opting faction already holds a minimum presence in the relevant territory
an event resolving a multi-season accumulation must be able to fire only once per entire campaign, never repeating even if its conditions recur later

ARC.ends_when: when a once-per-campaign trigger fires at a year-end checkpoint -- becoming live only once other factions have both weakened themselves sufficiently and instability is high while the neutral institution remains intact, OR once a separate arc's buffering character has independently broken; once live, any faction may attempt a roll to co-opt the neutral actor, and it is that roll's outcome, not a scheduled date, that resolves the arc. Absent the gating conditions, nothing forces resolution and the arc can simply continue accumulating indefinitely.

ARC.name: The Purple Shroud

unmapped.need: a public-order crisis must be able to require every resolution path to also force a SEPARATE, orthogonal political consequence bundled into it, such that there is no way to resolve the immediate crisis without also taking a position on a deeper structural question
an offer to resolve a crisis must be able to carry its true cost hidden or deferred from the receiving party at the moment of choice, revealed only afterward
a decision-maker's response to an identical offer must be able to be entirely determined by a single threshold stat with no free agency involved, when that decision-maker is not player-controlled
a documented personal vulnerability of a specific figure receiving an offer must be able to change the numeric size of that offer's cost if a faction exploits it via a social action
an operative's caution trait must be able to automatically veto a planned action based on a condition created by an ENTIRELY SEPARATE, earlier arc's unresolved consequence
a marginalized population's spontaneous show of solidarity during an unrelated crisis must be able to convert a single-axis crisis into a two-axis crisis that cannot be resolved along only one axis

a faction attempting to document a crisis in real time must be able to permanently preserve testimony from a marginalized group as a persistent record with continuing effect, distinct from and outlasting the crisis itself

ARC.ends_when: when the crisis is resolved by one of four named mechanisms -- direct intervention at a fixed cost, military suppression, mediated negotiation (which adds a season's delay), or a negotiated resolution scaled to the crisis's severity -- each of which forces a further, orthogonal social-consequence sub-resolution so that no path is consequence-free. If an NPC rather than a player controls the deciding faction, that 'choice' is a deterministic stat-lookup, not a free decision.

ARC.name: The Banker's War

unmapped.need: a faction must be able to simultaneously fund or ally with two mutually hostile factions in a way that materially profits it from EACH unit of conflict between them, as a deliberate strategy rather than an accident
detecting a hidden financial arrangement must be able to proceed along THREE independently-timed paths that can each succeed or fail on their own schedule without coordinating with each other

the concealing faction must be able to actively counter one specific detection path by feeding it curated or false information, as a discrete defensive action with a real chance to fully nullify that path's success

a party that detects a hidden arrangement must be able to choose to sit on that knowledge indefinitely as leverage rather than immediately exposing it, holding it as a standing advantage against the concealed party for as long as they choose

a subordinate who detects sensitive information, under a trait that predisposes him to act unilaterally, must be able to act on it alone rather than reporting to his own faction's leadership, thereby destroying that leadership's own separate, still-pending advantage

the party that finally exposes a hidden arrangement must be able to choose between a public disclosure (immediate, broad, one-time damage) and a private disclosure (an ongoing, renewable extraction of demands with escalating risk if a second party discovers it during that window)

an unrelated NPC's decades-old, since-revealed-mistaken assumption must be able to remain the causal source of that NPC's present-day detection capability, unaffected by learning the assumption was false

ARC.ends_when: when a party holding confirmed knowledge of the dual-funding scheme chooses to expose it, publicly or as private blackmail -- a genuine named choice belonging to whichever detection path succeeded and is acted on. ARC.name: The Empty Fort

unmapped.need: a faction leader must be able to deliberately choose a strategy that is locally suboptimal by every conventional metric because the suboptimal configuration produces a downstream political benefit that the optimal configuration would not

an opposing institution's decision to NOT act against a vulnerable target must be able to be a genuine, standing strategic choice, rather than mere neglect, and must be able to persist indefinitely without ever being forced to resolve
removing one unit of a spread-out presence must be able to itself generate a persistent legitimacy cost against the remover, in every instance, for as long as the underlying dynamic is active

a specific piece of caste-legitimizing evidence must be able to require a personal perceptual threshold to perceive at all, and that very threshold must be able to be suppressed by the same system the evidence would dissolve, producing a self-sustaining feedback loop

an investigator's thoroughness trait must be able to simultaneously serve an institution's stated goal (building a solid case) and undermine it (giving the target's allies a rescue window)

ARC.ends_when: never, by design -- this is explicitly a persistent background arc that runs for as long as the movement remains active, not a closing structure. ARC.name: The Sinigaglia Dinner

unmapped.need: detecting a subordinate's pattern of behavioral hesitation must be able to require repeated, unprompted checks over MULTIPLE seasons rather than a single roll, so that success is a matter of persistence and probability, not certainty on any one attempt

a superior's response to detecting a subordinate's disloyalty must be able to be fully determined by the superior's own current internal state via a fixed lookup, removing free choice from that decision point when the superior is not directly player-controlled

two parties in an adversarial relationship must be able to each hold damaging evidence against the other simultaneously, such that neither can act against the other without also being destroyed themselves

a defecting subordinate must be able to carry unreleased leverage with them into a new affiliation, handing that new faction a one-time strategic option they did not previously have

a case-handler assigned to investigate released evidence must be able to introduce a procedural delay that specifically benefits the ORIGINAL holder of that evidence in destroying it, even while nominally investigating on behalf of the institution that wants it exposed

ARC.ends_when: when the subordinate's fate resolves definitively -- through sustained compliance (an ongoing check that could still fail in a later season), a failed compliance check triggering outright defection, or, if the superior chooses confrontation/elimination, the subordinate's removal triggering automatic release of the mutually-destructive evidence. ARC.name: The Stolen Steward

ARC.ends_when: when the superior's year-end review roll succeeds -- its difficulty set by the number of factions currently holding an active influence channel -- and he chooses among three named dispositions for the administrator; on a failed roll, the review produces no resolution at all and the cultivation dynamic simply continues into further seasons with existing channels intact.

ARC.name: The World Without Direction

ARC.name: The Favour Gate

gains and losses to the same quantity in a period must be bounded so no single action fully solves the problem in one go

ARC.name: The Tied Vote

a failing outcome must visibly change how a watching third-party actor advances a separate, private running tally toward a future intervention

ARC.name: The Accounting Sequence

an action taken by a player at a small, personal scale must be able to silently register as also affecting a faction-scale quantity, invisible until the periodic accounting is read

ARC.ends_when: never, as an ongoing structural mechanism; as a focal arc it concludes at the accounting where two simultaneously-threatened factions' checks resolve and the triage choice takes effect

ARC.name: The Tutoring Demand

a person sent away as the compliant response must have a decaying allegiance value that ticks down every period unless someone spends effort maintaining it, with a floor beneath which the decay becomes irreversible
a person embedded inside the opposing power must be reachable only through a costly, uncertain action, and must be able to slow but not fully reverse the decaying allegiance above

the refusal path's accelerating pressure must feed a trade dependency that an unrelated economic faction notices and can eventually turn against the refusing side out of its own self-interest, not because it was ordered to

the eventual mass-combat event's outcome must depend on whether one specific, independently-judging military leader decides to commit her forces, and that decision must be resolvable in more than one way even under identical battlefield facts

ARC.ends_when: never as a single event -- Branch A resolves when the sent heir's status locks in (recovered, extracted, or lost) or Branch B resolves when the invasion battle concludes; both branches hand off into further political consequence

ARC.name: The Excommunication

unmapped.need: a single formal contest must support more than two outcome tiers, each with a categorically different consequence set, not merely a scaled version of the same consequence
the institution's best possible outcome must remove a suppression effect the target was providing against a background pressure quantity, and immediately spike that quantity

crossing an accumulating threshold on the spiking background quantity must trigger an automatic, self-sustaining escalation procedure that continues running each period without further single decisions

reversing a wrongly-decided formal judgment must require its own separate, high-cost formal procedure rather than a simple appeal

ARC.name: The Ceiral Ritual

unmapped.need: several independent long-running preparation tracks (a held object, a regional awareness value, a qualified lead individual, assembled qualified participants) must all reach specific thresholds simultaneously before the operation becomes available at all

the operation must resolve via one roll with at least four discrete outcome degrees, each producing a categorically different persistent world-state

the best outcome must permanently change what a specific location can be used for, and must cascade into other characters' independently-tracked knowledge/development thresholds becoming newly reachable
the failure outcome's substrate damage must interact with a pre-existing local weak point to make future failures of the same type more likely nearby

ARC.ends_when: never fully -- an Overwhelming result triggers an endgame-level structural change; any other degree leaves the operation re-attemptable, so it 'ends' only when a permanent-tier outcome is reached or the players give up

ARC.name: The General Falls

unmapped.need: a battle must have discrete resolution phases within a turn, with a stabilization action available only in one particular phase and only for a single turn's window
whether any character has invested in a specific, rarely-used skill area chosen at character creation (not in this scene) must gate whether the stabilization attempt can be made at all
a commander's incapacitation must impose an immediate structural penalty on the entire force's collective effectiveness and remove a stabilizing floor on morale, not just remove one combatant
failing to stabilize must escalate to a second, worse stage on the following turn, removing command capacity from the whole force rather than only worsening the commander's own state
a standing threat/threshold that exists only because one specific person personally maintains it must be permanently extinguished -- not paused, not inherited by a successor -- if that person dies
an opposing force defeating a leader in combat must be able to choose capture over death, creating a distinct ongoing leverage/hostage state different from either party surviving normally or dying

ARC.ends_when: the battle resolves and its immediate command-state consequence is set (recovered, uncommanded rout, capture, or death) -- a natural single-scene end; the aftermath vacuum is a separate, open-ended consequence

ARC.name: The Faction That Breaks

unmapped.need: an institution's overall health quantity reaching its floor must trigger a structural fracture into multiple independent successor entities, not merely a power reduction
the specific shape of the fracture must depend on the independent internal state of several named sub-actors at the moment of collapse, not on a fixed collapse template
a protective grace mechanism on the health quantity must be able to be missed if the players are not present to use their one available window

ARC.ends_when: never universally -- political-vacuum branches stabilize, reconstruction branches complete, or the frozen quantity later triggers a further cascade; no single terminal condition covers all branches

ARC.name: The Schoenland Pivot

that actor's read must depend only on externally visible signals, such that private mitigations are invisible to it while public/structural events are highly visible
the chosen alignment must change the ongoing rate of a separate, unrelated escalating pressure quantity on one path, and open automatic passive intelligence leakage to a hostile power on the other
the intelligence-leakage side effect must run passively and automatically regardless of player awareness, exposing covert operations run through that territory
locking in the favorable alignment must require meeting several externally-visible qualifying conditions simultaneously, not any single action
the third party's default disposition must remain profit-seeking/neutral even under alignment, able to pull back into self-interest rather than becoming a committed ally or true enemy

ARC.ends_when: never fully -- this is an ongoing background disposition that can flip again; it settles into a durable state only under sustained conditions on either side

ARC.name: The Duke Awakens

unmapped.need: an NPC's own repeated, self-directed institutional actions must silently accumulate a hidden personal quantity that the character himself is unaware of

crossing a threshold on that hidden quantity must trigger a one-time check whose two outcomes are qualitatively different: a true capability unlocked, versus a false self-generated belief acted on with full resources

the failure branch must produce behavior that is objectively counter-productive to the character's own interests while looking, to him, like the correct reading of his experience -- and must remain actable-upon with his full institutional resources

a second character who already possesses the same capability must be able to independently perceive the first character's growth and choose whether to disclose it, driven by a personal conflict-of-interest rather than a scripted trigger
the newly-unlocked capability must retroactively change how the character interprets and leverages his existing political relationships and leverage, not simply add a new resource

ARC.ends_when: never absolutely -- success opens into an ongoing high-level political integration arc; failure opens into an ongoing wrong-framework action arc that ends only when a subordinate's loyalty finally breaks or a formal investigation resolves

ARC.name: The Dissolution

unmapped.need: a single declared operation must resolve to at least four distinct outcome degrees, each combining differently whether the target is removed, whether a persistent breach forms, whether the actor is incapacitated, and how much a world-health quantity is spent

even the best possible outcome must produce a passive detection/visibility effect for sufficiently sensitive observers physically present, with a political consequence firing regardless of whether the primary goal succeeded
the worst outcome must spawn a hostile entity in the exact physical/social scene where the operation was attempted, with its type determined by what was targeted and at what scale

the ambient world-health quantity's pre-existing band must change what a bad outcome does next -- the same numeric penalty must cross into a qualitatively worse global band if the ambient quantity was already low, or be absorbed if it was high
an intermediate outcome must leave an unstable, still-active anomalous condition that deteriorates into the worst case after a fixed delay unless separately, deliberately addressed
removing a physical record via this operation must not remove the corresponding knowledge already held in people's minds

ARC.ends_when: the operation resolves in one roll -- a single-scene event; a Partial-outcome sub-arc ends when the unstable condition is mended or deteriorates into the worst case

ARC.name: Vaynard -- The Reckoner Who Saw the Sum

the transformed character must retain full continuity of prior goals, relationships, and decision framework, so others recognize him as unchanged in identity while being unable to independently verify his now-superior judgments
the transformed character must face a further, independent choice about whether to also alter his physical form, decoupled from the mental-threshold crossing itself
if the character holds ongoing political leverage, its meaning must be reinterpretable at a deeper level after the threshold without changing its face value to those who negotiated it originally

ARC.ends_when: never -- this is a durable state that persists for the remainder of the campaign; it has no closing condition of its own

ARC.name: Almud -- The King at the Limit of Order

two independently-transformed characters occupying the same physical space must be able to communicate with each other at full fidelity, distinct from their now-limited communication with everyone else

ARC.ends_when: Branch A never ends within this arc (the reign continues); Branch B ends the moment he formally vacates the throne, which is itself the trigger for a separate succession process outside this arc's scope

ARC.name: Lenneth -- What She Finally Understood

discovery of the transformation by one specific, relationally-close character must produce a fundamentally different scene depending on whether that discoverer has independently crossed the same threshold himself

a physical object with historical/informational significance must be able to carry a perceivable proximity relationship to a transformed character that is legible only to sufficiently sensitive observers

ARC.ends_when: never as background state; the discovery sub-arc ends at the discovery scene itself; a further political-action sub-arc ends when the act she was building toward is finally taken

ARC.name: The Quaestio of Baralta

ARC.name: Vaynard's Confession

ARC.name: The self-worsening spiral toward world-currency collapse

ARC.name: One institution's rise removes the counter-pressure against it

ARC.name: A practitioner's degrading stability erodes the relationship that could save it

The resource's degradation must be able to propagate OUT of the acting character entirely, imposing an accruing strain cost on a bonded SECOND character's own separate relational resource, on a fixed recurring interval, purely as a consequence of the first character's resource band.

That second character's relational resource, once sufficiently strained, must REMOVE the first character's access to one of their own resource's named recovery paths (the one depending on that bonded relationship being intact) — damage to a RELATIONSHIP resource must be able to gate access to an otherwise-unrelated PERSONAL resource's own recovery mechanic.

That SAME specific group's own separate institutional-standing resource must be able to be DRIVEN DOWN by the very factional instability that this loop's own automatic steps generate, creating a path by which the loop damages the standing of the one actor positioned to stop it.

That group's institutional-standing resource crossing its OWN floor must strip the group's access to its one counter-action specifically, at the same time as (or as a consequence of) the instability that the loop's own progression produced — the disabling condition and the loop's own automatic progression must share a common cause.

ARC.ends_when: the specific group succeeds at its counter-action before its own standing collapses, reversing the metric and holding the window open — or its standing collapses first (a threshold firing, nobody deciding), closing the counter-path and leaving the underlying destabilization to continue via the loop's other, automatic effects — or, per the UNCLEAR need above, it is not fully specified whether 'the window closing' additionally means ordinary access reversing on its own.

If fixed point were refused, the honest word would be CANONICALLY ORDERED, not order-independent, and every document would have to change the word.
